cvEn:
Yosef Atdagi, son of Ester and Shlomo, was born on 7 Tammuz 5694 (20 June 1934) in the city of Tetouan in Morocco. He completed his studies at the high school in Casablanca. He immigrated to Israel in 1950 as part of the Youth Aliyah program. At first he was in a youth group in the Negev, but later, when his parents needed his help, he left and worked on Moshav Yesha.

In June 1952 he was drafted into the IDF. He served as an officer in the regular army after completing the armored corps officers' school. In this course he excelled, and he was sent to France for further training, where he was also among the outstanding officers. Throughout his studies he longed to return to Israel and to his parents, to whom he was very close. At the end of the course he flew back to Israel. However, fate was not kind to him, and he was among the passengers on the El Al aircraft that was shot down by a deliberate attack over Bulgarian skies on 8 Av 5715 (27 July 1955). He was laid to rest in the civilian cemetery in Kiryat Shaul. His parents donated a Torah scroll, and on the anniversary of his death they placed it in the synagogue of Moshav Yesha.
